moodys.citation_text: Moody's Ratings maintained FHH's rating of Baa1 (per June 2024 affirmation), implying multi-year hold at Baa1.

sp.citation_text: Trade press references Moody's and Fitch only for FHH; no S&P rating identified.

fitch.citation_text: 'FHH had maintained an A- rating since September 2018' — therefore A- in effect at 2022-12-31. Outlook Stable inferred.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Operating losses of ~$20.8M (FY22) and $34M (FY23); slower-than-expected recovery in operating performance since fiscal 2022.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'In May 2024, Fitch had downgraded the hospital from A- to BBB+, with FHH having maintained an A- rating since September 2018.'

moodys.citation_text: Moody's Baa1 maintained through June 2024 affirmation. PARTIALLY VERIFIED — outlook may have been moved to negative; conservative assumption Negative given Fitch action.

fitch.citation_text: Post-May 2024 downgrade BBB+ in effect. Later Fitch action (BBB+ to BBB and Rating Watch Negative) was AFTER the Jan 27, 2025 ransomware attack but per trade press positioning, the BBB action was still relatively close to window end. As of 2025-03-31 Fitch was BBB+/Negative.

outcome_class_rationale: Fitch downgraded FHH one notch from A- to BBB+ in May 2024 within the window. A subsequent Fitch downgrade to BBB with Rating Watch Negative followed a Jan 27, 2025 ransomware attack — that BBB action could fall before or after window-end 2025-03-31. If both Fitch actions occurred within the window, this becomes MULTI_DOWNGRADE; as-conservatively-attested DOWNGRADE (one notch confirmed).
